'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Mike Damboise LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Damboise]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Objective listed Echo Base Operations near end; Careful Planning (V) also present.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Damboise]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Echo Base Operations / Special Modifications|Echo Base Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
